summary: Butler County, AL 120 ft lookout built by the CCC in 1936 as the McKenzie Lookout, moved in 1966 by the Alabama Forestry Commission, and NHLR-registered in 2009.

facts.status_note: Register describes the tower at its present site; no later condition report found

events.note: Built by the Civilian Conservation Corps and known as McKenzie Lookout (register Built field: 1936)
Moved by the Alabama Forestry Commission to its present location
Registered June 23, 2009 as US 814, AL 15; nominated by Thomas Kaufmann

evidence.supports: built by the CCC, known as McKenzie Lookout, 120 ft tall
evidence.quote: The tall 120' McGowin Lookout was built by the CCC and known as McKenzie Lookout.

evidence.supports: moved in 1966 by the Alabama Forestry Commission to its present location
evidence.quote: It was moved in 1966 by the Alabama Forestry Commission to its present location.

evidence.supports: the CCC stopped building fire towers when the US entered WWII; some were left unfinished
evidence.quote: the Civilian Conservation Corps ceased building firetowers

evidence.supports: many Alabama lookouts are unsafe and illegal to climb
evidence.quote: are very unsafe, and are illegal to climb

sources.title: Thomas Kaufmann: Keeping Alabama's historic lookout towers

notes_for_editor: The 1936 build date, CCC origin, McKenzie name and 1966 move come from the register page alone; two WebSearch queries found no second source, and the cached Forest Lookouts Alabama index does not list McGowin. The 1819 column supports only the general CCC timeline, not this tower. height_m 36.6 is the register's 120 ft, not a design record. The name Thomas Kaufmann matches the column's author; the story names him only as the register nominator and does not assert they are the same person without checking. Worth verifying the 1936 date and the 1966 move with Alabama Forestry Commission or Butler County records before publishing. No photos added.
